summary.text: Steven Young, a Green Party of Minnesota attorney and veteran and a member of the Minneapolis Food Council, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Governor of Minnesota to Amy Klobuchar.
He ran with Jane Kirby, a retired midwife and animal rights activist, as his running mate.

paragraphs.text: Young lives in Minneapolis and works as a Metro Transit light rail operator, according to his KAXE candidate survey response.
In that response he described his background as twelve years in the U.S. Marine Corps and nine years as a lawyer.
He received 1.8% of the vote to Amy Klobuchar's 55.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: Amy Klobuchar will face off against Lisa Demuth in Minnesota governor's race
